mentions.name: Defense of Solaris
mentions.description: A co-op roguelite tower defense game inspired by classic Warcraft III custom maps such as YouTD, playable online at the project's website.
mentions.source_excerpt: I have made a co-op roguelite tower defense game inspired by the old Warcraft III maps. A major inspiration was YouTD. You can play it here: https://defense-of-solaris.com/
